tableLines.line: 🎁 "OH! You can hold more now! We've been HOLDING this — take it, take it, take it!" (The System's gift awaits — choose an ability.)
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Howard speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Howard speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
🔇 The birds have gone quiet. Even the crickets. The woods are holding their breath.
Sanne: "Bilberry is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
It is holding a meeting. About you.
"WALKOUT! WALKOUT!" It climbs onto the bullhorn and stops fighting entirely — full-time coordination. (Allies +8 damage. The rep is UNTARGETABLE while coordinating.)
You can't get a clean shot — it's behind the picket line, bullhorn up, coordinating. (Untargetable during WALKOUT — break the line first.)
"The line — the LINE is broken!" The bullhorn wavers. Nobody is chanting anymore. It climbs down, pencil out. (The walkout collapsed — it is TARGETABLE again. End it.)

🍖 THE BUNDLE — six different gifts on one table (foraged feast, monster meat, tested and cooked, preserved food, a guest of honor, a kept recipe, a donated keepsake-channel). The village did not just eat — it showed what it can do. (+4 ladder points to the climb.)
💔 A faction of Thornfield has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 3 people under Felix.
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Tomás.

FUSION REACTOR: the pellet goes in — properly, inside you. A warm hum starts behind your ribs and settles. You will never be hungry again. One reactor per world: yours. It does not come out. (The System is DELIGHTED. That should worry you.)

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.

The little star inside Christian goes quiet — and wakes up inside Nora. Christian never got hungry while the village did, so the pellet moved to hungrier hands: Nora will never be hungry again while it hums, and Christian is hungry again, for the first time in a long while. The table can hear a feast again.
🧳 Stonebridge has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table II. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A kite over the treeline. Nobody is holding the string. On its screen, for a frame: you, from above.
You don't know what that was. A kite with no string, holding station over the trees. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table II. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Feared. The show's narration lingers on your hands.
David: "tawny trumpet flowers on arching stems, buds like golden needles is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
With Haven grieving, Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 6,000 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.
